targets.title: Improvements in problem behavior in a child with autism spectrum diagnosis through synthesized analysis and treatment: A replication in an EIBI home program.
targets.evidence_quote:
Although this study replicated the results of previous
studies (e.g., Strand and Eldevik 2018) limitations can
be noted.
targets.outcome_quote:
This study demonstrated the successful replication of
the practical functional assessment and treatment de-
scribed previously in several studies by a limited num-
ber of researchers within an early intensive behavior
intervention (EIBI) program in a clinical setting.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly conclude successful replication and specifically name Strand and Eldevik as a study whose results replicated. Limitations do not retract that verdict.

reasoning: An independent child sample retests the intervention results. Strand and Eldevik is the closest explicitly named study in the replication chain. Hanley and other IISCA studies introduce the intervention literature and materials; the paper does not separately specify retesting each of their findings. Supplied cache was inspected first and contained an abstract and references only; a matching full PDF with all authors and references was acquired.
